visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long, straight light-brown hair and a white silky wrap-style dress sits at a white marble counter. She has a subtle, flirtatious smile and wears gold earrings. The background is a brightly lit, modern living space with neutral walls and a faint marble accent wall. (2) A sharp cut to another woman sitting in a kitchen area. She has brown hair tied back, wears black-rimmed glasses, and a black crew-neck sweatshirt. Her expression is one of confusion and mild irritation as she looks off-camera. A large LG refrigerator is visible behind her. (3) The scene returns to the first woman in the white dress. She leans forward slightly, resting her chin near her hands, and points her index finger towards the viewer with a playful, knowing expression. (4) Back to the second woman in glasses; her expression remains skeptical and deadpan. (5) A transition occurs to a grayscale, hand-drawn sketch of the first woman. Her expression in the sketch is one of deep sadness or rejection, with exaggerated down-turned eyebrows and a somber gaze. (6) The video returns to real-life footage of the second woman in the kitchen. She is now smiling slightly as she speaks to someone off-camera. (7) The first woman reappears, holding up two fingers in a V-sign while smiling brightly. (8) The second woman laughs, leaning her head back slightly. (9) A dramatic reaction from the first woman as her hair is blown upward and outward by an unseen force, her mouth wide open in a scream. (10) A series of highly stylized, black-and-white manga-inspired sketches depict the woman in various states of extreme shock, horror, and distress with exaggerated facial features and intense shading.
